description: What tools/run.py faces shows (docs/faces.md): the review heads (an assembler recipe), the two skin tones of the final test, per-head iris and brow colours, and the game's first-person camera read from the game repo (D:/prime-game, read only, 2026-10-03 at c43c0e1): client/player/player.tscn has a Camera3D with no fov set, so Godot's default 75 degrees vertical (keep height); content/modes/base_mode.tres eye_height_m = 1.6; project.godot sets no anti-aliasing (MSAA and screen-space AA off) and stretch mode canvas_items; the target screen is 1920 x 1080.
